title: Pomponius Porphyrio, Commentum in Horatium Flaccum — Porphyrio's commentary on Horace; Порфирион, «Комментарий к Горацию». Proposed unit: on the Ars poetica
author: Pomponius Porphyrio
genre: School commentary on all of Horace
edition: Meyer, Teubner 1874; Holder, Innsbruck 1894 (both public domain); Latin text in the Perseus catalogue
ru_evidence: ru.wikipedia 'Помпоний Порфирион' lists no translation; Russian search found none
en_evidence: No translation found. R. Pearse (blog, 2013) wishes the Horace scholia 'existed in English'
other_translations: None found (only studies, e.g. Formenti, MOM Éditions)
value: Oldest complete surviving Latin commentary on a poet: Horace's persons, realia, figures and metres. Preserves Neoptolemus of Parium's poetics (Ars poetica). Key for Horace studies, ancient literary criticism and the history of schooling
ai_feasibility: high — terse, clear prose; minor textual problems
pilot_unit: Commentary on the Ars poetica (est. 8–10k words); alternatively Odes Book 1
